title: Authority-only SDK composition bypasses parent model authorization by omitting mandatory control
causalEvidence: Original-source root and isolated authority-only starts omit the parent bootstrap. The unchanged real-child example rejects the complete old SDK graph. Private observation on that graph runs two actual children without a resource budget or model-access service: both skip parent authorization, including a request explicitly denied by its parent that still reaches the child adapter. Updated source and built Node22/24 apply exactly one captured-scope parent check, permit the positive adapter call and prevent the denied call before dispatch.
behavior: Execution authority on the initiating Agent requires private SDK parent control, just like parent model policy or resource admission. The retained parent scope governs each child model dispatch. Existing standalone execution still applies when all three services are absent; no model defaults or user grants are broadened.
